title: David Forgives Saul in the Cave
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler with the brave heart, and tonight David has his enemy in reach and lets him go: Beau keeps his fists in his pockets when his cousin knocks his castle down on purpose.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because it takes a brave heart to hold back. In Beau’s world today: his cousin knocks over Beau’s block castle on purpose and laughs. Beau’s hands turn into fists, and he wants to knock over his cousin’s castle too. Beau stops. He takes a big breath, puts his hands in his pockets, and says, “That hurt my feelings.” Then he starts to build again. Just like David in the cave, Beau learned that being kind when you could get even is the bravest thing of all.
